injuries_home.name: Jordan Goodwin
injuries_home.note: Goodwin (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game against Portland.

injuries_home.name: Rasheer Fleming
injuries_home.note: Fleming is out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a sprained left ankle.

injuries_home.name: Mark Williams
injuries_home.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries_away.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries_away.note: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.

injuries_away.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries_away.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries_away.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries_away.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries_away.name: Noah Penda
injuries_away.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries_away.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries_away.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries_home.name: Gui Santos
injuries_home.note: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

injuries_home.name: Kristaps Porziņģis
injuries_home.note: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

injuries_home.name: Moses Moody
injuries_home.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries_home.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries_home.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
